an4.110:1.8: Evam eva kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me āsīvisūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.110:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo āgataviso hoti na ghoraviso?
an4.110:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati,
an4.110:2.3: so ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
an4.110:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo āgataviso hoti na ghoraviso,
an4.110:2.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave āsīviso āgataviso na ghoraviso,
an4.110:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo ghoraviso hoti na āgataviso?
an4.110:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo na h' eva kho abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati,
an4.110:3.3: so ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
an4.110:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo āgataviso ca hoti ghoraviso ca.
an4.110:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati,
an4.110:4.3: so ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
an4.110:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo n' evāgataviso hoti na ghoraviso?
an4.110:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo na h' eva kho abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati,
an4.110:5.3: so ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
an4.110:5.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo n' evāgataviso hoti na ghoraviso,
an4.110:5.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave āsīviso n' evāgataviso na ghoraviso,
an4.110:5.7: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro āsīvisūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti.
